messages:
Maria: FYI — Aperture Systems wants a boardroom touchpoint tomorrow. POC is paused. Three blockers: SSO cert/IP allowlist, pilot pricing approval, SOC2/KMS questions from their security team. Can we triage?
Liam: Tech summary: their infra requires IP allowlist + SAML 2.0. We also need to provide a short runbook for session tokens and KV cache TTLs. Waiting on SAML metadata from their IdP.
Liam: SAML snippet they asked for (we gave them this template):
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://redwood.example.com\">...SAML metadata...
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Maria: @Liam can you confirm exact IP ranges they must add for the Websocket endpoints? Ops is asking for CIDRs we control.
Liam: Yes — current public egress for prod is 52.21.96.0/19 and 13.248.0.0/13. Tell them to allow 52.21.96.0/19, 13.248.0.0/13. Will validate with eng-infra if we add any ephemeral ranges for dedicated pools.
Asha: Security note — Aperture asked for SOC2 type II report, recent pen test summary, and whether we support BYO-KMS (customer-managed). Do we have a timeline to deliver SOC2 artifacts?
Priya: Legal: we need signed NDA + DPA before sharing some of the artifacts. I can send a redlined DPA today but need the customer legal point. Also checklist: data flow diagram, subprocessors list.
Greg: Revenue ops perspective — they want a pilot pricing cap and an exec-level discount ask. What's the estimated ARR if pilot succeeds? I can only sign off on any pilot discount with committed ARR or exec approval.
Maria: Estimated ARR is $600k ARR if pilot converts. Pilot scope: 3 teams, ~12 seats, expected 3-month pilot volume. Customer asks for 50% pilot discount and 90-day trial credits.
Greg: 50% is steep. Recommend 30% + $15k in pilot credits for 90 days, contingent on exec signoff. @Maria can you take that to the CRO?
Maria: Will escalate now. @Priya can you confirm fastest path to get the DPA/NDA signed? I can loop in their GC.
Priya: I’ll draft the DPA template and push to them today. If the GC signs by EOD we can share SOC2 artifacts tomorrow (redacted).
Asha: Also need confirmation on BYO-KMS: we support customer-managed keys for Private deployments only; for Hosted we offer KMS integrations (GCP/AWS) but keys are provider-managed. I’ll prepare a one-page security brief to share.
Liam: One more tech risk: latency SLO when behind their IP allowlist + private peering — might need dedicated pool. Estimated latency bump 15–30ms unless we map to eu-west region. Flagging for product.
Maria: Action items so far: 1) Maria -> escalate pricing to CRO (in progress). 2) Liam -> finalize IP ranges + SAML template (ETA 1h). 3) Priya -> DPA draft + share path (ETA 3h). 4) Asha -> one-pager on SOC2/KMS + BYO constraints (ETA EOD). 5) Greg -> price fallback proposal (30% + $15k credits).
Greg: I'll standby and prep the finance justification for the discount.
deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: \"Aperture Systems board touchpoint\" — tomorrow 09:30 PT. Organizer: Maria.
Maria: Thanks — if we can get the DPA and IP ranges before the call we can avoid exec-only follow-up. I'll DM the CRO and GC. :pray:
